The Bacterial_Canker reference images are a striking match for the test image. Both show:
- Elongated leaves with serrated/notched margins
- Brown/reddish-brown necrosis along the leaf edges
- Green central leaf tissue with margin discoloration
- Same gray marble-like surface background
- The characteristic irregular margin browning pattern

This is clearly **Bacterial_Canker**, not Cutting_Weevil (which shows clean triangular chunks cut away leaving bare stems).
